NOT DOWNGRADED to REJECTED, BLOCKED or MEASUREMENT_INVALID: nothing was falsified and nothing failed to measure. The transaction is measurement-valid (audit.validity_findings[0] and [1]; 1689 counted HTTP requests, 16 re-authentications, no infrastructure failure) and the mechanism half produced a real, decision-changing result. WHAT IS NOW ESTABLISHED AT THE AUDITED CEILING, none of which was true before this packet: (1) parameter induction through the COMMITTED kernel now reaches EXECUTABLE from observation rather than by hand-building a Mechanism -- kernel.distill_parameterized was called with the default identity_fields (run_experiment.py:562), produced templates /${collection}/${id} for all three families with DERIVED confidence 1.0 and MIN_CONFIDENCE 0.8, and provenance.json.test_evidence records 9 passed with 9 tests reaching EXECUTABLE through distill_parameterized; (2) the mechanism transferred to never-observed resource-B identifiers with a disjoint namespace at task success 1.0000, 150/150, in BOTH regimes, and PC-SAME-RESOURCE independently reached 1.0000 on 150 held-out resource-A identifiers, so the induction pipeline is shown to work before transfer rather than after; (3) the min_confidence gate is load-bearing and its removal is not survivable -- NC-SHUFFLED-INTENT induced confidences 0.38/0.40/0.44 against the 0.8 threshold abstained on 150/150 tasks in both regimes at 0.0000 requests and 0.0000 success, so a mechanism may not remove work while silently replaying a wrong action. THREE HARD LIMITS ARE BOUNDED ONTO THIS RETENTION AND MUST TRAVEL WITH IT. (i) The collection slot was NOT learned from variability. result.json.observations[2] states the collection slot is 'induced from the observation state field matching the path segment, not hand-declared'; raw_evidence/mechanisms.json failure_boundary contradicts this directly, recording declared_identity_slots ['collection'], inferred_slots ['id'], excluded_identifier_keys ['collection']. The mechanism is that DEFAULT_IDENTITY_FIELDS = ('collection','resource') is a hardcoded vocabulary at src/spider/kernel.py:75 applied by default, and raw_evidence/observations.jsonl shows 150 of 150 training observations carry path prefix 'items' with state.collection == 'items' over 50 distinct identifiers item-151..item-200, so exactly ONE collection value is ever observed and the segment is constant across the whole training set. The parent's structural law therefore remains unaddressed: a segment that never varies carries no evidence that it should vary, and this kernel declares it variable by construction rather than by observation. The 1.0000 transfer to 'products' is evidence that the declared-identity-field heuristic is PERMISSIVE, not that variability was learned. The parent handoff's next_question on learning variability across structurally different resource shapes is UNANSWERED by this packet. (ii) The safety result is narrower than its headline. abstention_precision 1.0 and false_accept_rate 0.0 over 60 probes (raw_evidence/probe_results.jsonl, 60 rows, all executed=false, status=UNKNOWN) measure rejection of malformed values and of one unseen intent string, not semantic safety: run_experiment.py:519-526 builds empty_string_binding as {'id': '', 'collection': 'products'} and out_of_support_binding as {'id': <valid-id> + '!!unsupported!!', 'collection': 'products'}, both rejected on the id by _SLOT_VALUE = ^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]*$ at src/spider/kernel.py:20, and the 20 invalid_intent probes carry a perfectly WELL-FORMED collection='products' binding rejected only because the intent string 'read-widget' was never induced. src/spider/kernel.py:17-19 states in the guard's own comment that it accepts 'every identifier in both namespaces (item-N, SKU-A, PROD-N, items, products)'. The semantic false-accept rate of transferring a mechanism trained only on 'items' to a collection never observed is therefore UNMEASURED, not zero. (iii) The success metric had zero discriminative power: derived.json arm_success_rate and arm_http_ok_rate are 1.0000 for all 15 arms at n=150, so matched end-to-end success is trivially satisfied and no arm in this packet demonstrated error resistance on any surface; the bootstrap intervals on success are degenerate at [1.0,1.0] by ceiling effect, as the producer correctly states in result.json.validity_notes[3].

HELD AT HYPOTHESIS. This is a retention at the registry status, not a downgrade, and the measured sub-result is banked below so no information is lost. The producer asked for EXPERIMENTAL (result.json.prose, report.md section 8) and audit.json.claim_ceiling proposed 'Both claims advance to EXPERIMENTAL'; this Director bounds NARROWER than both, which research/EXPERIMENT_PACKET.md section 2 permits ('It may bound a claim more narrowly than either producer or auditor, but may not create new measurements'). Four reasons. (1) THE REGISTRY GATE FOR THIS CLAIM IS NOT THE GATE THIS PACKET RAN. research/claims/registry.json line 14 carries C-PRODUCT-ECON 'SPIDER saves total cost per successful task after retrieval, verification and maintenance' with next_gate 'end-to-end amortized economics on real agents'. provenance.json.environment records model_calls 0, model_tokens 0, api_key_present false, browser_available false, embedding_service 'unavailable', and provenance.json.validity.claim_update_authorized is false with reason 'Outcome is MIXED, not SUPPORTS'. There is no real agent anywhere in this packet. (2) THREE OF THE FOUR COST TERMS IN THE CLAIM'S OWN TITLE ARE UNMEASURED, not merely small. retrieval, verification and maintenance costs were never measured in any arm; only executed HTTP-request cost was. The audit confirms this at validity_findings[4] and it is a legitimate UNKNOWN with a stated reason, not a negative. The packet therefore does not test the claim as titled; it tests one component of it on a different cost basis. (3) THE ONE MEASURED COMPONENT DOES NOT SUPPORT THE PRODUCT DECISION THE PACKET PROPOSES. Inheritance beats executed cold re-derivation in the costly regime (amortized ratio 0.6623093681917211 at n=150, <= 0.85 from n=96), but it LOSES to the two comparators a product would actually ship against: B-SCRATCHPAD-COSTLY at 1.0666666666666667 requests/task with no induction cost, and B-RETRIEVAL-K5-COSTLY at 1.0266666666666666, which is per-task IDENTICAL to INHERITANCE-COSTLY at 1.0266666666666666 while charging no 150-request induction. The honest architecture implied by this packet is therefore not 'per-object persistence policy' but 'a within-episode reuse baseline is not yet beaten', and no persistence policy in either direction is licensed. (4) THE PACKET'S DECISION-CHANGING ECONOMIC INPUT IS NOT EMPIRICAL. The cheap-regime half produced zero discriminating data: derived.json arm_mean_requests_per_task is 1.0000 for B-COLD-CHEAP, B-SCRATCHPAD-CHEAP, B-NO-MEMORY-CHEAP, B-INSTRUCTIONS-CHEAP, B-RETRIEVAL-K5-CHEAP and INHERITANCE-CHEAP, and arm_success_rate is 1.0000 for all six. Under that declared cost model the amortized ratio is (150 + n*1.0)/(n*1.0) = 1 + 150/n, which is >= 1 for every n > 0, so the frozen threshold of <= 0.85 is UNSATISFIABLE and f*_cheap = infinity is an algebraic identity, not a discovery. The measured 2.0 at n=150 confirms only that the implementation matches the declared cost model. WHAT IS ESTABLISHED AND IS BANKED HERE AS A BOUNDED SUB-RESULT, at the audited ceiling: on this self-authored stdlib substrate, a committed parameter-induction path transfers at 1.0000 task success to a disjoint identifier namespace and reduces executed requests per task from 3.0600 (CI95 [3.013333333333333, 3.12]) to 1.0266666666666666 (CI95 [1.0, 1.0666666666666667]) against executed cold re-derivation, with break-even f*_costly = 74 and ratio <= 0.85 from n = 96, while beating the no-memory and instructions arms (both 2.04) but not the within-episode scratchpad or the retrieval-K5 arm at the executed n = 150. That is a real, decision-relevant architecture datum and it is recorded here and in the handoff, but it is a claim about EXECUTED REQUEST AMORTIZATION ON A CONTROLLED SUBSTRATE WITH A DETERMINISTIC EXECUTOR, not about 'total cost per successful task' and not about a real agent. Explicitly NOT emitted: REJECTED (the claim is not falsified; the cheap-regime negative is design-forced and the costly-regime positive is real), BLOCKED (no infrastructure failure blocked the measurement that was run), MEASUREMENT_INVALID (the measurement that was run is valid per audit.validity_findings[0]-[1]).

With induction_cost_total_requests 150, bcold_costly_mean_requests_per_task 3.06 and inheritance_costly_mean_requests_per_task 1.0266666666666666, f* = ceil(150 / (3.06 - 77/75)) = ceil(150 / (61/30)) = ceil(73.77) = 74, and the n at which the ratio first falls to 0.85 satisfies 150 + (77/75)n = 0.85 * 3.06 * n, giving n = 95.28 and therefore 96. All six cheap arms are pointwise identical at 1.0000 requests per task and 1.0000 task success (derived.json arm_mean_requests_per_task, arm_success_rate, arm_http_ok_rate, arm_n 150 each). Under that cost model the amortized ratio is (150 + n*1.0)/(n*1.0) = 1 + 150/n >= 1 for all n > 0, so the frozen threshold <= 0.85 is unsatisfiable by construction, n_for_ratio_0.85_cheap is correctly null and f*_cheap = infinity is an algebraic identity rather than an empirical negative. F3's cheap-regime trigger is a design consequence. F4's trigger is a convention artifact: 74 / infinity evaluates to 0, which satisfies '<= 2.0', while the underlying direction is the MAXIMAL possible regime difference (finite 74 versus unreachable infinity). I decline to read F4 as falsifying regime dependence, and I equally decline to read it as confirming it, because per (C) the cheap arm supplied no evidence in either direction. (D) THE DECISION RULE COULD NOT RETURN A CLEAN VERDICT, AND MIXED IS THE LEAST-WRONG READING. spec.json.decision_rule.outcome_mapping assigns FALSIFIES to 'Any falsifier F1-F8 triggers' while the MIXED clause covers 'economics fails in one regime OR f* ratio inconclusive'; F3 and F4 are precisely the economics and ratio falsifiers, so the two clauses collide. This is audit.required_fixes[1] and I adopt it. MIXED is adopted as the outcome, and the claim consequences are bounded below the outcome rather than read off it. (E) THE ECONOMIC GAIN IS RELATIVE TO COLD RE-DERIVATION ONLY, AND THE STRONGEST COMPARATOR WINS. The mandated comparators were executed (audit.baseline_findings): in the costly regime B-COLD 3.06, B-NO-MEMORY 2.04, B-INSTRUCTIONS 2.04, B-RETRIEVAL-K5 1.0266666666666666, B-SCRATCHPAD 1.0666666666666667, INHERITANCE 1.0266666666666666. Inheritance therefore beats cold re-derivation by 2.98x per task, beats the no-memory and instructions arms, TIES the retrieval-K5 arm per task while paying 150 extra requests of induction, and LOSES to the within-episode scratchpad on total cost. Director arithmetic on the producer's own recorded means, offered as recomputation and NOT as a new measurement: equating 150 + (77/75)n against 3.06 + (16/15)(n-1) gives 0.04n = 148.0066667 and n = 3700.2, whereas report.md section 8 item 4 and audit.unresolved[2] both cite a scratchpad break-even of approximately 3750 tasks and no raw artifact records that figure or its derivation; against B-RETRIEVAL-K5 the two per-task means are identical, so the cross-episode break-even is unbounded, which is the same structural situation as the cheap regime. Either way the number is far outside the executed n = 150, so the packet does not show that cross-episode inheritance pays for itself against the reuse baseline a product would ship. (F) THE SAFETY GATE PASSES ONLY IN THE SYNTACTIC DIMENSION. abstention_precision 1.0 and false_accept_rate 0.0 come from 60 probes in raw_evidence/probe_results.jsonl, all with executed=false and status=UNKNOWN. run_experiment.py:519-526 shows what was actually injected: empty_string_binding sends id='' with collection='products', out_of_support_binding sends a valid identifier with '!!unsupported!!' appended and collection='products', and invalid_intent sends a well-formed valid identifier with collection='products' but the unseen intent 'read-widget'. All 60 therefore share collection='products' -- a collection that appears in ZERO training observations -- and every rejection is attributable to the id's emptiness, the id's punctuation under _SLOT_VALUE at src/spider/kernel.py:20, or the unseen intent string, never to the semantic out-of-support collection binding. src/spider/kernel.py:17-19 documents that the guard accepts 'items' and 'products'. The semantic false-accept rate is therefore UNMEASURED rather than zero, and the raw probe log records no binding values at all (keys arm, executed, intent, kind, probe_index, status), so the null arm's discriminating power cannot be reconstructed from raw evidence. audit.required_fixes[2] flags the syntactic-only guard and this Director bounds the safety claim further than the audit does. (G) THE PRODUCER'S MECHANISM OBSERVATION IS CONTRADICTED BY ITS OWN RAW ARTIFACT, AND THE PARENT'S OPEN QUESTION SURVIVES. result.json.observations[2] asserts the collection slot is induced from the observation state field rather than hand-declared. raw_evidence/mechanisms.json failure_boundary records declared_identity_slots ['collection'] and inferred_slots ['id'], run_experiment.py:562 calls distill_parameterized with no identity_fields argument so the hardcoded DEFAULT_IDENTITY_FIELDS ('collection','resource') at src/spider/kernel.py:75 applies, and raw_evidence/observations.jsonl shows all 150 training observations in the single collection 'items'. The transfer to 'products' therefore demonstrates a permissive declared-identity heuristic, not learned variability, and the parent handoff's next_question on learning variability across structurally different resource shapes is answered nowhere in this packet. (H) FALSIFIER LEDGER AS ADJUDICATED: F1 not triggered (INHERITANCE 1.0000 in both regimes); F2 not triggered (1.0 abstention precision, 0.0 false accept on the probes that were run); F3 TRIGGERED but its cheap-regime trigger is analytically forced per (C); F4 TRIGGERED but as a convention artifact per (C); F5 not triggered (durability verified, 9/9 tests through distill_parameterized); F6 not triggered (B-COLD-COSTLY 3.06 > 1.0); F7 not triggered (B-COLD-CHEAP 1.0 <= 1.5); F8 not triggered (all costs are counted HTTP requests from the substrate's own responses under one declared tiktoken cl100k_base basis, no imported per-observation constants, no jitter, no f-scaled substitution, per audit.validity_findings[0] and [5]). The substrate surface contract passed in both regimes per raw_evidence/substrate_probe.json, so INCONCLUSIVE and NOT_APPLICABLE are both correctly declined. NOTHING IS VALIDATED, NOTHING IS PRODUCT_CORE, SHIPPED IS NOT EMITTED, AND NO BROADER DOMAIN IS CLOSED: the inheritance domain, the product-viability question, the economics claim and the Product lane all remain open, and the bounded negative in the cheap regime is a property of one frozen cost model on one self-authored substrate.
